linkedin.notes: DISABLED 2026-08-06: Playwright adapter drives a logged-in session, prohibited by User Agreement 8.2.13. Re-enable only after the adapter is rewritten to the official Posts API (w_member_social / w_organization_social).

x.notes: DISABLED 2026-08-06: Playwright adapter is off-API. Re-enable after rewrite to X API v2 POST /2/tweets. Pay-per-use.

facebook.notes: Higher anti-bot friction. Personal feed only, no groups in v1.

instagram.notes: Media-heavy. Requires square or vertical images.

reddit.notes: Subreddit rules vary wildly. Risk of bans for promotional content.

pinterest.notes: DISABLED 2026-08-06: Playwright adapter is off-API, and API v5 Trial-tier Pins are visible only to their creator. Needs Standard access.

tiktok.notes: DISABLED 2026-08-06: Playwright adapter is off-API. Content Posting API restricts unaudited clients to private viewing. Video-first.

snapchat.notes: DISABLED 2026-08-06: Playwright adapter is off-API. Public Profile API requires a Public Profile and .mp4 6-60s at min 540x960.

bluesky.notes: DISABLED 2026-08-03 by Dave: no Bluesky account exists. Adapter is written and works via the open AT Protocol API if an account is ever created.
